reason: My cousin lost his deposit to a page that just vanished, so I'm not sending money up front to a name I've never heard of. I'd wait until I see real unboxing videos on TikTok or a friend tells me their order actually showed up.
objection: I pay the item price first and then wait 2 to 3 weeks. If they disappear in that time, who do I chase? A written quote means nothing if the page is gone.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or a TikTok creator I follow showing their order arriving from them, or letting me pay everything on delivery for my first order.
